notes: Tested: a custom auth config created without `oauth_redirect_uri` sends `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add`. Register exactly the URI your auth config sends, or set `oauth_redirect_uri` to `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback` and register that instead.
Composio supports custom OAuth configurations for Shopify via `OAUTH2` and `S2S_OAUTH2` auth schemes.
The default callback redirect URI expected by Composio is `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add`.
Ensure order update or history fetching issues are resolved by including `read_all_orders` to prevent 403 errors.
Always specify the `subdomain` connection field when initializing an auth link for a merchant store.

assumption: An AI agent that reads and writes products, orders, and customer data across multiple Shopify merchant stores via OAuth.

verdict.headline: Shopify provides self-serve app registration for testing, but public app deployment requires review and strict compliance checks.
verdict.summary: Developers can instantly create apps in the Shopify Partners dashboard for development and testing. However, distributing a public app or handling sensitive customer data requires Shopify app review and quality checks, which can introduce delays.

handsOnEffort.label: 2–4 hours
handsOnEffort.basis: Configuring app credentials, redirect URIs, and setting up the authorization code grant flow.

timeToFirstConnection.label: Instant
timeToFirstConnection.basis: Shopify Partners dashboard allows immediate app creation and test store installation.

timeToProduction.label: 1–3 weeks
timeToProduction.basis: Official guidelines cite 5–10 business days for app review; developer reports indicate multi-week cycles.

verdict.longestPole: Shopify app review process and automated quality checks.
verdict.costDetail: Creating a Shopify Partner account and test stores is free. Production requires a Shopify store subscription depending on the merchant tier.

easierPaths.condition: Building a custom app for a single tenant store
easierPaths.effect: Bypasses app review entirely and allows direct internal API integration.

factors.detail: Developers can instantly create accounts and register apps via the Shopify Partners dashboard.
Public apps distributed via the Shopify App Store or unlisted install links require review and automated quality checks.
Shopify requires developer identity verification and app security review for public listings.
Security requirements must be met during app store review, especially when accessing protected customer data.
Partner dashboard and development stores are free; merchant billing depends on their respective store plan.
Anyone can sign up for a Shopify Partner account without enterprise sales approval.
Custom apps and development stores do not enforce rigid merchant caps before testing.
Each merchant store requires installing the app via the OAuth authorization flow using their specific store subdomain.

phases.title: Register your Shopify App
phases.outcome: You have a Shopify Partner account, a development store, and a registered app client ID and client secret.

steps.title: Sign up for a Shopify Partner account
steps.details: Go to the Shopify Partners portal and register for a free account. This grants access to the Dev Dashboard for creating and managing test apps.

steps.title: Create a development store
steps.details: In your **Shopify Partners Dashboard**, navigate to **Stores → Add store → Create development store**. Use this store to test OAuth installation flows and API calls.

steps.title: Create a new app in the Dev Dashboard
steps.details: In the **Shopify Partners Dashboard**, go to **Apps → Create app**. Choose to build an app manually or configure a custom app depending on whether you are distributing publicly or wiring up a single-tenant store.
steps.agentAssist: Agent can draft app naming conventions, descriptions, and metadata requirements.

phases.title: Configure OAuth Credentials & Redirect URIs
phases.outcome: Your app configuration includes the correct callback URLs, required scopes, and client credentials ready for Composio.

steps.title: Configure authorized redirect URIs
steps.details: In your app configuration under **Configuration → URLs**, set the allowed redirection URL to `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add` (or `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback` depending on your routing setup).
steps.agentAssist: Agent can verify redirect URLs against the active Composio routing endpoints.

steps.title: Select API access scopes
steps.details: Configure required access scopes in your app settings. Standard agent permissions include `read_products`, `write_products`, `read_orders`, `write_orders`, `read_customers`, `write_customers`, `read_inventory`, `write_inventory`, `read_fulfillments`, `write_fulfillments`, `read_assigned_fulfillment_orders`, `write_assigned_fulfillment_orders`, `read_content`, `write_content`, `read_themes`, `write_themes`, `read_locations`, `read_shipping`, `write_shipping`, `read_gift_cards`, `write_gift_cards`, `read_script_tags`, `write_script_tags`, `read_marketing_events`, `write_marketing_events`, `read_price_rules`, `write_price_rules`, `read_discounts`, `write_discounts`, `read_draft_orders`, `write_draft_orders`, `read_metaobjects`, `write_metaobjects`, `read_webhooks`, `write_webhooks`, and `read_publications`.
steps.agentAssist: Agent can generate a minimal scope manifest matching the specific workflows needed for the AI agent.

steps.title: Retrieve client ID and client secret
steps.details: Copy your **Client ID** and **Client Secret** from the app's configuration overview page. Store these securely to input into Composio.

phases.title: Test with Your Development Store
phases.outcome: OAuth handshake completes successfully and your test store issues a valid access token.

steps.title: Execute the authorization flow
steps.details: Initiate the authorization request by pointing your browser or integration to `https://{shop}.myshopify.com/admin/oauth/authorize` with your `client_id`, `scope`, and `redirect_uri`.
steps.agentAssist: Agent can test generating request URLs and validating parameter correctness.

steps.title: Exchange the authorization code for an access token
steps.details: Send a `POST` request to `https://{shop}.myshopify.com/admin/oauth/access_token` containing `client_id`, `client_secret`, and `code`. Verify the returned HMAC signature.
steps.agentAssist: Agent can automate the POST exchange and validate token responses.

phases.title: Prepare for Review & Go Live
phases.outcome: App meets platform requirements for public distribution or protected customer data access.

steps.title: Fulfill app review requirements
steps.details: Ensure your app complies with Shopify App Store requirements, including privacy policies, secure token storage, and proper error handling.
steps.agentAssist: Agent can draft privacy policies, review checklists, and demo script outlines.

steps.title: Submit app for review
steps.details: Submit your app via the **Shopify Partners Dashboard** for automated quality checks and human review. Wait for review completion.
steps.agentAssist: Agent can monitor submission status via API or check logs.

phases.title: Go live in Composio
phases.outcome: Shopify is fully connected to Composio with custom OAuth credentials ready for AI agent actions.

steps.title: Configure custom auth in Composio
steps.details: Create a custom OAuth2 auth configuration for the `shopify` toolkit in Composio using your Client ID, Client Secret, and required scopes.
steps.agentAssist: Agent can execute the Composio API call to register the custom auth config.

steps.title: Initiate connection session with store subdomain
steps.details: Provide the merchant's `subdomain` as an extra connection field when triggering the Composio auth link generation.
steps.agentAssist: Agent can pass the subdomain parameter programmatically.

Needed to test OAuth installation flows and API requests.

Public apps must pass automated quality checks and Shopify review.

blockers.title: Missing read_all_orders scope causing 403 errors
blockers.symptom: Order list API requests return a 403 Forbidden status code when attempting to fetch order history beyond recent entries.
blockers.howToProceed: Reconnect your Shopify integration in Composio with the `read_all_orders` scope explicitly requested.

blockers.title: App not found or expired default app error
blockers.symptom: Users see an 'App not found' error when attempting to connect using default credentials.
blockers.howToProceed: Use your own custom Shopify OAuth app credentials rather than default shared apps.

blockers.title: App review delays
blockers.symptom: Public app submission remains under review past the standard 5–10 business day window.
blockers.howToProceed: Check partner dashboard messages for automated quality check failures or feedback requests and resubmit promptly.

nuances.title: Rate Limit Tiers
nuances.detail: Shopify uses a leaky bucket algorithm. REST Admin API limits range from 2 requests/s (Standard) up to 20 requests/s (Shopify Plus). GraphQL Admin API points range from 100 points/s up to 1,000 points/s.

nuances.title: Access Token Lifetimes
nuances.detail: Public apps must use offline access tokens (persistent access until uninstalled or revoked) or online tokens (tied to an active 24-hour staff session).

nuances.title: Protected Customer Data
nuances.detail: Accessing customer PII scopes requires explicit Level 2 approval in the Shopify Partner Dashboard before going live.

steps: Register your app in the Shopify Partners Dashboard and copy your Client ID and Client Secret.
Configure `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add` as your allowed redirect URL in Shopify app settings.
Navigate to the Composio dashboard or use the Composio API to create a custom OAuth2 auth config for the `shopify` toolkit.

Provide your Shopify Client ID, Client Secret, and required scopes (e.g., `read_products`, `write_products`, `read_orders`, `read_orders`, `read_customers`, `read_inventory`) in the Composio auth config.
Pass the store `subdomain` as an extra connection field when initiating a connection session.
Complete the OAuth login flow on your `myshopify.com` store domain to establish the connection.
